## Frontmatter-repair findings

### drop-final-claimed-at

- [warning] drop-final-claimed-at (docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md)
  This finished change still has a `claimed_at` timestamp from when it was being built.
  It's harmless: nothing reads it once a change is closed. Older docket versions left it behind.
  remedy: Run `docket repository repair` to remove it (it shows the edit first), or delete the `claimed_at:` line in `.docket/docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md` by hand and commit and push it from `.docket`.

### quote-unsafe-scalar

- [warning] quote-unsafe-scalar (docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md)
  `title: yes` is unquoted, and YAML can misread values shaped like this.
  docket reads it correctly today; quoting is safe and does not change the value.
  remedy: Run `docket repository repair` to add the quotes (it shows the edit first), or quote the `title:` value in `.docket/docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md` by hand and commit and push it from `.docket`.

### scalar-to-list

- [warning] scalar-to-list (docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md)
  `depends_on: 3, 4` is written as plain text, not a list.
  docket can't read it as a list, so it ignores these ids.
  remedy: Run `docket repository repair` to rewrite it as `[3, 4]` (it shows the edit first), or rewrite it as `depends_on: [3, 4]` in `.docket/docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md` by hand and commit and push it from `.docket`.

### ambiguous value

- [error] frontmatter-manual-review (docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md)
  `title: true` is unquoted, so YAML reads it as something other than the text `true`.
  docket can't tell whether you meant the text or the YAML value, so it won't change it for you.
  remedy: Write `title: 'true'` if you meant the text, or correct the value in `.docket/docs/changes/archive/2026-05-28-0001-wisdom-ai-bastion.md`, commit and push it from `.docket`, then run `docket repository repair` so the board and link blocks catch up.
